description: Emperor Time factory hooks. Short. They bite.

hooks.command: if [ -f scripts/boot.sh ]; then bash scripts/boot.sh; elif [ -f scripts/boot.ps1 ]; then pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/boot.ps1; elif [ -f scripts/emperor.cmd ]; then cmd.exe /c scripts\emperor.cmd boot; fi

if [ -f scripts/activate.sh ]; then bash scripts/activate.sh; elif [ -f scripts/activate.ps1 ]; then pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/activate.ps1; elif [ -f scripts/lib/activate.py ]; then python3 scripts/lib/activate.py; fi

hooks.prompt: Emperor Time: make software. MUST-route is already on — do not wait for the client to say emperor time. Read ACTIVATION next= from the activate card (or run scripts/emperor activate) and open that skill before clarifying questions. Do not ask OS or language; read .emperor/host.env and .emperor/survey.md. Resume .emperor/state.md. Before setup thrash: scripts/emperor ask-spec --emit "<ask>" --write .emperor/tasks/<id>/ask-spec.md (effort_class caps critique/finish/grill; missing class → tiny hard cap). If no task: scripts/emperor queue next. Lost trees: skills/emperor-excavate. DONE is scripts/emperor done / emperor.ps1 done / emperor.cmd done. Leaf: skills/emperor-resume/must-route.md. Memory is CONJECTURE.

hooks.command: last=''; if [ -d .emperor/tasks ]; then last=$(ls -1d .emperor/tasks/* 2>/dev/null | tail -n1); fi; if [ -n "$last" ] && [ -f "$last/DONE.md" ]; then if command -v pwsh >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -f scripts/emperor.ps1 ]; then pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/emperor.ps1 done "$last" || echo '[Emperor Time] STOP: DONE probes failed'; elif [ -f scripts/emperor ]; then bash scripts/emperor done "$last" || echo '[Emperor Time] STOP: DONE probes failed'; elif [ -f scripts/emperor.cmd ]; then cmd.exe /c scripts\emperor.cmd done "$last" || echo '[Emperor Time] STOP: DONE probes failed'; else bash scripts/done.sh "$last" || echo '[Emperor Time] STOP: DONE probes failed'; fi; elif [ -d .emperor/tasks ]; then echo '[Emperor Time] STOP: no DONE.md'; fi
